title: heartbeat payload, agent to server every heartbeat_seconds; doubles as keep-alive

dropped_events.description: Deprecated alias kept for older agents; `lost_events` is the field to read.

clock_suspect.description: The agent clock jumped or disagrees with the server by more than 120 s.

lost_events.description: Events the agent could not keep (queue overflow, store failure) since start.

store_error.description: Last local store error, absent when healthy.

dead_letters.description: Events set aside after a final rejection or repeated failure.
